classification_observation.supported: The actual table explicitly labels these products prismatic single cells in the lithium-ion section. Retaining lithium_ion chemistry and prismatic form is supported.
classification_observation.not_verified: The short-form table does not establish each selected prismatic model as a foil pouch or certify a rigid/metal case. A generic cell-can illustration is labelled as one structure example.
classification_observation.recommended_wording: No explicit pouch evidence is selected, so these references remain in the standalone prismatic research category. Do not turn this editorial grouping into a verified assertion that every model is necessarily non-pouch or metal-cased.

limitations: This review does not verify school procurement, stock, consumer retail availability, charger compatibility, hardware modifications or asset condition.
Corporate manufacturer identity is supported by the selected sources; manufacturing-site and batch provenance are not established.
Detailed capacity discharge conditions, protection circuits and terminal/wrapping variants remain outside the selected tables.
The fragment access dates record the original research date. This independent reopening occurred on 2026-10-03 Australia/Sydney; source dates were not edited.
No external services, canonical files, original research fragment or application logic were changed.
